plugins.name: dark-fantasy
plugins.description: Dark fantasy inspired: a castle on a sea cliff under a violet sky, with lightning, fog, waves, a bridge of torches and a knight by a campfire in a cave.

plugins.name: disco-elysium
plugins.description: Disco Elysium inspired: a frozen harbour town under a painted expressionist sky, with an aerostat, cranes, smoke and a lit church.

plugins.name: silent-hill-2
plugins.description: Silent Hill 2 inspired: an overlook above a fogged valley of pines, with an abandoned car, a flickering streetlight, falling ash and a turn to rust about once a minute.

plugins.name: cyberpunk-2077
plugins.description: Cyberpunk 2077 inspired: a neon megacity seen from a dusty roadside, with a wedge sports car, flying cars and a looping day-to-night cycle.

plugins.name: village
plugins.description: Resident Evil Village inspired: a snowbound valley in a storm, with a gothic castle on a ridge, a village in the fog, a turning windmill and falling snow.

plugins.name: outlast
plugins.description: Outlast inspired: a remote asylum on a mountain at night in a rainstorm, seen through a camcorder that switches to night vision.

plugins.name: alan-wake
plugins.description: Alan Wake inspired: a lake at night, a lighthouse beam sweeping the water, and a man on a dock searching the far shore with a flashlight.

plugins.name: red-dead-redemption-2
plugins.description: Red Dead Redemption 2 inspired: a camp by a mountain river at blue hour, with a cowboy by the fire, a grazing horse and snowy peaks.

plugins.name: firewatch
plugins.description: Firewatch inspired: ridge after ridge of pine forest at sunset, a fire lookout tower and the smoke of a distant wildfire.
